news.headline: Exhibit tables added: One last chance to showcase your startup at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
news.summary: Last chance to grab exhibit space at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026—applications reopen through September 30. Showcase your startup at SF's Moscone West (Oct 13-15) in front of 10,000+ founders, investors, and tech leaders.

news.headline: Binance takes $100M stake in Circle under expanded USDC deal
news.summary: Binance is doubling down on stablecoins with a $100M equity stake in Circle, sealing a five-year partnership that includes monthly incentives to boost USDC adoption. The expanded deal signals major players betting big on regulated digital dollar infrastructure.

educational.title: What Cloud Computing Actually Means
points: "The cloud" is just someone else's data center, rented over the internet
It lets companies scale computing power up or down without buying hardware
Three big providers dominate: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud
This is why AI's growth is tightly linked to cloud/data-center spending
Nearly every app you use — banking, social media, streaming — runs on someone's cloud
